{{Top}}
The '''Myriad Visual System – MK. 2''' was a viewing software, part of the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]]. Thanks to this device, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] could "see" in several different modes, accepting signals from the [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] and processing it according to the droid's internal commands. The "Human" mode allowed the droid to see in the visual spectrum of [[Human/Legends|Human]] beings. Other modes included a neon mode that enhanced [[Color/Legends|color]] saturation, and an infrared mode that allowed the droid to see in the dark.
